diagnosis: Spindle epithelial tumour with thymus-like elements
legend: A multinodular periphery is noted as it expands into the adjacent thyroid gland parenchyma. The spindled cells are relatively bland and interlaced with tubulopapillary structures, cysts, and glands. Cleft-like spaces containing grey-blue mucin are common.
